def closest_pair_sum(nums, target):
    """返回和最接近target的两个下标。"""
    pairs = sorted((v, i) for i, v in enumerate(nums))
    lo, hi = 0, len(pairs) - 1
    best_diff = float('inf')
    best_pair = None
    while lo < hi:
        s = pairs[lo][0] + pairs[hi][0]
        diff = abs(s - target)
        if diff < best_diff or (diff == best_diff and pairs[hi][1] < best_pair[1]):
            best_diff = diff
            best_pair = (pairs[lo][1], pairs[hi][1])
        if s < target:
            lo += 1
        elif s > target:
            hi -= 1
        else:
            break
    i, j = best_pair
    return [min(i, j), max(i, j)]
